'''Darth Hoth Kill Those Pesky Jedi v2.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 27 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HD Hoth DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

thanks for the reviews, here's the new one.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

first turn: (1st action) use Mobilization combo to get Carida. With the 4 Vader's and Blizzard 4 in there, you should be able to get Vader out and flip the objective by the end of the first turn. Use IAO to find a battleground DB.

Subsequent turns: continue to get out the DB's and try to get the other Dark Jedi, all the while, eliminating the opponent's Jedi.

Card choices:

Mobilization Points combo-gets out Carida and subtracts from Jedi defense value.

IAO combo-search for DB's and make opponent use force to retrieve.

Crush-limit opponent's BD at mobile locations and search for IHYN.

Lord Vader-the best form of Vader for this deck.

DV,DLOTS-short a few Lord Vaders, this is the next best.

Darth Maul-can duel opponent's Jedi when I get out TWBNMFY

Aurra Sing-good against Jedi

SSA-1015-adds to the Jedi deploy cost

Visage-in case the other gets canceled and high destiny

The Phantom Menace-Maul's immunity and high destiny

No Escape-ruins HotJ and take top card of lost pile into hand

Drop!-get's cards back into used pile

TWBNMFY-let's Maul duel

I Have You Now-adds destiny where with a Rebel.

Vader's Anger-add 1 to lightsaber destiny or stack a destiny

Young Fool-kill the person with Force Lightning then PooPed with Young Fool

mobile DB's-Crush works there

Cor:DB-high transit and extra force.

Carida:to overcome Battle Plan

Vader's saber-adds to force drains

Aurra Sing's Blaster-cancel Jedi immunity and high destiny.

Shewski: thanks for the review, and especially for giving me ideas of what to take out. I think I have a good idea of how this will look next time.
